enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, fan running for air circulation, room kept quiet and dark.
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow under head. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket down slightly. Breathe deeply. Turn onto back. Place arm over eyes. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back up. Turn to left side. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed, using the shared bathroom before Member 3's 06:30 slot.
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Turn off fan. Put feet on floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet face with water. Apply soap to face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Walk to bedroom. Put on clean clothes. Comb hair.

enriched_activities.activity: Daily reading of a book and light stretching, keeping quiet while other members use the bathroom and kitchen.
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up book from desk. Sit on bed. Open book to bookmark. Read pages. Close book. Place book on bed. Stand up. Stretch arms overhead. Bend forward to touch toes. Stretch legs. Sit on floor. Do light yoga poses. Lie on back. Pull knees to chest. Roll to side. Stand up. Pick up book again. Sit on bed. Read more pages.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a keto breakfast of eggs and avocado, checking the shared house calendar while eating, having breakfast alongside Member 1, Member 2 and Member 3.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and avocado. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs with fork. Cut avocado in half. Scoop avocado into bowl. Put pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs and avocado on plate. Sit at table. Look at shared house calendar on wall. Say 'Good morning' to Member 1, Member 2, and Member 3. Eat breakfast with fork. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Scrolling X and replying to Messenger messages about cancelled shifts under the lockdown.
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Unlock screen. Tap X app. Scroll through feed. Tap on a post. Read comments. Scroll more. Open Messenger app. Read messages about cancelled shifts. Tap reply box. Type response. Send message. Read next message. Type another reply. Send. Close Messenger. Open X again. Scroll more. Lock phone. Put phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet desk study with the desk lamp on, reviewing Commerce and Engineering lecture notes on the computer.
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open lecture notes file. Read notes. Highlight key points. Open notebook. Pick up pen. Write notes. Turn page. Continue reading. Type additional notes on computer. Save file. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending an online university lecture remotely because of the public-health lockdown, taking written notes.
enriched_activities.desc: Open laptop. Join online lecture via Zoom. Turn on camera. Mute microphone. Listen to lecturer. Open notebook. Pick up pen. Write notes. Type questions in chat. Read chat responses. Take more notes. Stretch arms. Adjust desk lamp. Continue listening. Write summary. Leave meeting. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle for tea and making a low-carb snack, sharing a short tea break with Member 1 and Member 2.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Get mug from cupboard. Place tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Add milk. Stir with spoon. Sit at table with Member 1 and Member 2. Drink tea. Eat low-carb snack.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on a Commerce and Engineering assignment at the desk computer in the quiet study space.
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open assignment document. Read instructions. Type paragraph. Check references. Open browser. Search for source. Copy citation. Paste into document. Continue typing. Save document. Stretch back. Open notes. Read. Type more. Save again.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a keto lunch of leftovers from the freezer, checking prices on a bargain-hunting app, eating alongside Member 1, Member 3, Member 4 and Member 5.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open freezer. Take out leftovers. Close freezer. Place leftovers in microwave. Set timer. Start microwave. Open bargain-hunting app on phone. Check prices. Microwave beeps. Take out food. Sit at table with Member 1, Member 3, Member 4, and Member 5. Eat lunch. Talk about lockdown news. Open app again. Check more prices. Finish eating.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and loading the dishwasher and wiping down shared kitchen surfaces alongside Member 2 and Member 3.
enriched_activities.desc: Clear dishes from table. Carry dishes to sink. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Wipe down kitchen counters with cloth. Rinse cloth. Wipe again. Talk to Member 2 and Member 3. Put away dry dishes. Wipe table. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Joining an online tutorial and posting questions in the unit group chat.
enriched_activities.desc: Open laptop. Join online tutorial. Turn on camera. Mute microphone. Listen to tutor. Open unit group chat. Type question. Send. Read responses. Take notes. Type another question. Send. Read answers. Participate in discussion. Leave tutorial. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing the neobank budget on the phone, checking the list of six to ten subscriptions and cancelling unwanted ones.
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Unlock. Open neobank app. Check account balance. Scroll through transactions. Open subscriptions list. Review each subscription. Tap cancel on unwanted ones. Confirm cancellation. Check budget categories. Adjust budget amounts. Lock phone. Put phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Updating the monthly paper planner and noting upcoming assignment due dates and possible shift changes.
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up paper planner from desk. Open to current month. Pick up pen. Write assignment due dates. Write possible shift changes. Check phone calendar. Add notes. Turn page. Write reminders. Close planner. Place planner on desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Revising for exams and drafting assignment sections at the desk.
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open exam revision notes. Read through notes. Highlight key concepts. Open assignment draft. Type new section. Check word count. Save document. Stand up. Stretch. Sit back down. Read more notes. Type more. Save again. Open practice questions. Answer questions. Check answers.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a book to unwind in a quiet, low-stimulation space.
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up book. Sit in chair. Open book to bookmark. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Place book on lap. Look out window. Open book again. Read another chapter. Close book. Stand up. Place book on desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Batch cooking keto meals for the week and preparing dinner, sharing the kitchen with Member 1, Member 3, Member 4 and Member 5 who are also cooking.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables on cutting board. Put pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir with spoon. Add vegetables. Stir again. Add spices. Cover pot. Simmer. Talk to Member 1, Member 3, Member 4, and Member 5. Stir pot. Turn off stove.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and reading news updates about the lockdown on the phone, alongside Member 1, Member 3, Member 4 and Member 5.
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table with Member 1, Member 3, Member 4, and Member 5. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Pick up phone. Open news app. Read lockdown updates. Put phone down. Continue eating. Talk to Member 1. Pick up phone again. Read more news. Finish eating. Place fork on plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Portioning and freezing the low-carb keto servings and washing up, alongside Member 1, Member 4 and Member 5 who are also cleaning up.
enriched_activities.desc: Take out containers from cupboard. Spoon leftovers into containers. Close lids. Label containers with marker. Open freezer. Place containers in freezer. Close freezer. Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Wash pots and pans. Rinse. Place on drying rack. Wipe counters. Talk to Member 1, Member 4, and Member 5.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the washing machine with a load of laundry and starting it, using the bathroom right after Member 3's shower slot.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Load dirty clothes into machine. Add detergent. Close washing machine door. Turn dial to setting. Press start button. Check machine runs. Walk to bedroom. Wait. Return to bathroom. Check machine. Walk back to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting health and insurance paperwork, organising documents into labelled folders and writing down questions about the forms.
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open drawer. Take out health and insurance paperwork. Sort papers into piles. Open folder. Place papers in folder. Write labels on folder. Pick up pen. Write questions on notepad. Check forms. Staple papers. Place in folder. Close drawer. Open next folder. Repeat sorting. Write more questions.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly with reduced-motion settings on the phone to wind down while Member 1 uses the bathroom.
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Unlock. Open reading app. Adjust reduced-motion settings. Read article. Scroll down. Read more. Open book on phone. Read pages. Tap to turn page. Read more. Adjust brightness. Continue reading. Lock phone. Place phone on bedside table.

enriched_activities.activity: Quick evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed, using the bathroom after Member 1's evening wash and before Member 5's slot.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed with reduced-motion settings on the phone before sleep.
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over legs. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open reading app. Read chapter. Tap to turn page. Read more. Adjust pillow. Continue reading. Lock phone. Place phone on bedside table. Turn off lamp. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the room kept quiet and dark for the night.
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket down. Breathe deeply. Turn onto back. Place arm over eyes. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back up. Turn to left side. Remain still.
